title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall entering shortened week featuring jobs data, war uncertainty
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，进入缩短的一周，就业数据、战争不确定性
summary: Trump continues to rock markets with a lack of consistency as the Iran war enters its second month.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗战争进入第二个月，特朗普继续以缺乏一致性的方式震撼市场。

title: A bold 2011 market call is echoed in 2026
title_zh: 2011 年大胆的市场预测与 2026 年相呼应
summary: If you only have time for one metric, it should be earnings. They’re the most important long-term driver of stock prices.
summary_zh: 如果你只有时间衡量一个指标，那么它应该是收入。它们是股价最重要的长期驱动因素。

title: Meta and Google lost a major social media addiction lawsuit. Their troubles are far from over.
title_zh: Meta 和谷歌在一场重大社交媒体成瘾诉讼中败诉。他们的麻烦还远未结束。
summary: The verdict in the landmark social media addiction lawsuit could make its way to the Supreme Court.
summary_zh: 具有里程碑意义的社交媒体成瘾诉讼的判决可能会提交最高法院。

title: Almost everything is going wrong for markets right now
title_zh: 目前市场几乎一切都出了问题
summary: The stock market appeared to capitulate to its fears on Friday, with the S&P 500 falling into the 6,300s. But it wasn't just stocks — bonds, gold, bitcoin, and market hopes and dreams all had a rough week.
summary_zh: 周五股市似乎屈服于担忧情绪，标准普尔 500 指数跌至 6,300 点。但不仅仅是股票——债券、黄金、比特币以及市场的希望和梦想都经历了艰难的一周。

title: OpenClaw is taking the tech world by storm. Here's what you need to know about it.
title_zh: OpenClaw 正在席卷科技界。以下是您需要了解的内容。
summary: OpenClaw is getting a lot of attention from AI enthusiasts and boosters. Here's what it is and why it matters.
summary_zh: OpenClaw 受到了人工智能爱好者和支持者的广泛关注。这就是它是什么以及为什么它很重要。
